events_engagement_param_extracted.name: events_engagement_param_extracted
events_engagement_param_extracted.body_sql:
SELECT
  event_date,
  event_timestamp,
  event_name,
  user_pseudo_id,
  SAFE_CAST(ep.value.string_value AS FLOAT64) AS engagement_time_msec
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
  AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
events_engagement_param_extracted.description: Explode event_params to extract engagement_time_msec as a numeric (milliseconds). One row per original event parameter instance; includes event-level and user identifiers for downstream grouping.

customers_who_bought_product_cohort.name: customers_who_bought_product_cohort
customers_who_bought_product_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(fullVisitorId AS STRING) AS fullVisitorId,
  p.v2ProductName AS product_name,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS date,
  visitId,
  h.hitNumber AS hitNumber
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
UNNEST(hits) AS h
LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p ON TRUE
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.v2ProductName <> ''
customers_who_bought_product_cohort.description: Cohort of customers (fullVisitorId) who purchased a product with a given product_name during the session date range. Exposes one row per customer per matching purchase instance (keeps duplicates so later dedup/exists logic can be applied).

traffic_source_yearly_revenue.name: traffic_source_yearly_revenue
traffic_source_yearly_revenue.body_sql:
SELECT
  trafficSource.source AS trafficSource_source,
  SUM(
    -- hit-level transaction revenue; hits.transaction.transactionRevenue is INT64 in micros of the site's currency.
    -- Use SAFE_CAST to ensure nulls are treated as zero.
    COALESCE(h.transaction.transactionRevenue, 0)
  ) AS yearly_total_transactionRevenue
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
WHERE
  -- Date shards: lift literal out of view per instructions (caller should filter _TABLE_SUFFIX).
  -- This view expects callers to filter _TABLE_SUFFIX to the desired calendar year, e.g. BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'.
  TRUE
GROUP BY
  trafficSource.source
traffic_source_yearly_revenue.description: Yearly aggregated total transaction revenue per traffic source. Sums hit-level hits.transaction.transactionRevenue grouped by trafficSource.source for the calendar year. Keeps the yearly total to rank traffic sources.

product_revenue_by_source_and_day.name: product_revenue_by_source_and_day
product_revenue_by_source_and_day.body_sql:
SELECT
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS date,
  trafficSource.source AS trafficSource_source,
  SUM(IFNULL(p.productRevenue, 0)) AS daily_product_revenue
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN @start_date AND @end_date
GROUP BY
  date,
  trafficSource_source
product_revenue_by_source_and_day.description: Daily aggregated product revenue per traffic source. One row per trafficSource.source and date (YYYYMMDD). Sums raw productRevenue (not converted to millions). Useful to compute total revenue per source over the whole period and to compute max daily revenue per source.

session_hits_product_revenue_flags.name: session_hits_product_revenue_flags
session_hits_product_revenue_flags.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- session identifiers (carry key columns)
  CAST(fullVisitorId AS STRING) AS fullVisitorId,
  visitId,
  visitStartTime,
  date,
  -- hit & product identifiers from exploded hits and products
  h.hitNumber AS hitNumber,
  p.productSKU AS productSKU,
  -- product revenue (as stored on the product record within a hit)
  p.productRevenue AS productRevenue
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE
  -- filter shards by date range lifted out of the view (user should supply BETWEEN bounds when querying the view)
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'

semantic_filters._TABLE_SUFFIX: RANGE_FILTER (put actual suffix bounds in question_ops)

session_hits_product_revenue_flags.description: Exploded view (one row per session.hit.product occurrence) indicating productRevenue values found in hits.products for a session. Useful to detect whether a session contains any non-zero product revenue.

product_purchases_by_visitor_july.name: product_purchases_by_visitor_july
product_purchases_by_visitor_july.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- carry the visitor id to keep the view joinable
  CAST(fullVisitorId AS STRING) AS fullVisitorId,
  -- product name (exclude NULL/empty in WHERE)
  p.v2ProductName AS productName,
  -- total quantity of this product purchased by this visitor during July (sum of itemQuantity)
  SUM(COALESCE(p.productQuantity, 0)) AS total_item_quantity_july
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE
  -- restrict to July across shards using _TABLE_SUFFIX; lift exact month bounds into query usage
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160701' AND '20170731' -- placeholder range covering possible July shards; caller should replace with exact July range like '20160701'..'20160731' or '20170701'..'20170731'
  -- ensure hit is a transaction/item-related hit: use presence of productQuantity or transactionId in item/product
  AND (p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL OR p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL)
  -- restrict to rows whose date is in July (lift month literal out; here we filter by substring for month = '07')
  AND SUBSTR(date, 5, 2) = '07'
  -- exclude NULL/empty product names
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(p.v2ProductName) <> ''
GROUP BY
  fullVisitorId,
  p.v2ProductName
product_purchases_by_visitor_july.description: Aggregate item quantities per visitor and product name for all product purchases in July. One row per visitor + productName, with total quantity purchased in July. Excludes rows with NULL/empty productName so downstream filters don't need to re-clean names.

user_session_day.name: user_session_day
user_session_day.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(fullVisitorId, CAST(visitorId AS STRING)) AS user_id,
  date AS session_date,
  fullVisitorId,
  visitorId,
  visitId,
  visitNumber,
  visitStartTime,
  device.isMobile AS is_mobile,
  totals.visits AS totals_visits,
  totals.hits AS totals_hits,
  totals.pageviews AS totals_pageviews
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
user_session_day.description: One row per user-session-day (a session record) normalized to identify the user id (prefer fullVisitorId, fallback to visitorId as string), the session date, session identifiers, and whether the session's device is mobile. Keep raw session-level totals and flags to allow downstream aggregation.

user_transaction_hits.name: user_transaction_hits
user_transaction_hits.body_sql:
SELECT
  fullVisitorId AS user_id,
  h.transaction.transactionId AS transaction_id,
  date AS transaction_date,
  visitId,
  visitNumber,
  SAFE_CAST(device.isMobile AS BOOL) AS is_mobile,
  h.hitNumber AS hitNumber
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  AND h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
user_transaction_hits.description: One row per transaction hit (a hit inside hits array with a non-null transaction.transactionId) annotated with the enclosing session identifiers, hit date (session date), and whether the enclosing session is mobile. This view extracts transaction occurrences to compute first-transaction dates per user and to link transactions to session device properties.

ga_session_hit_ecommerce_actions.name: ga_session_hit_ecommerce_actions
ga_session_hit_ecommerce_actions.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- key/session columns carried through
  CAST(fullVisitorId AS STRING) AS fullVisitorId,
  CAST(visitId AS INT64) AS visitId,
  CAST(visitStartTime AS INT64) AS visitStartTime,
  date,
  h.hitNumber AS hitNumber,
  -- ecommerce action type (as provided on the hit)
  h.eCommerceAction.action_type AS ecommerce_action_type,
  -- flags for common ecommerce action types (lifted literals should be applied outside the view)
  -- Here we produce boolean flags based on action_type values commonly used: 'ADD', 'ADD_TO_CART', 'PURCHASE', 'DETAIL', etc.
  -- The exact string-to-flag mapping should be filtered/normalized by the consuming query if different.
  LOWER(IFNULL(h.eCommerceAction.action_type, '')) IN ('add', 'add_to_cart', 'add_to_cart_action', 'addtocart', 'add_to_cart_action_type') AS is_add_to_cart,
  LOWER(IFNULL(h.eCommerceAction.action_type, '')) IN ('purchase', 'buy', 'transaction', 'order') AS is_purchase,
  LOWER(IFNULL(h.eCommerceAction.action_type, '')) IN ('detail', 'product_detail', 'product_detail_view', 'detail_view') AS is_product_detail_view
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
WHERE
  -- when using the wildcard table, consumers must restrict the date range via _TABLE_SUFFIX
  TRUE
ga_session_hit_ecommerce_actions.description: Normalized hit-level ecommerce action information: one row per hit (unnested hits) with the hit's eCommerceAction.action_type and hit-level keys and date. Keeps flags useful for filtering/categorization (is_add_to_cart, is_purchase, is_product_detail_view).

ga_product_monthly_product_level_cohort.name: ga_product_monthly_product_level_cohort
ga_product_monthly_product_level_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX)) AS month,
  ecommerce_action_type,
  SUM(product_occurrences) AS product_occurrences
FROM (
  SELECT
    _TABLE_SUFFIX,
    COALESCE(h.eCommerceAction.action_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS ecommerce_action_type,
    1 AS product_occurrences
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h,
    UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE
    _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    -- Lifted literal: exclude product impressions when requested via question_ops.
    -- To exclude impressions, downstream callers should add filtering on h.type or h.isImpression via WHERE clause.
)
GROUP BY
  month,
  ecommerce_action_type
ga_product_monthly_product_level_cohort.description: Monthly aggregated counts of product-level occurrences by ecommerce action type (counts of unnested product rows classified by hit.eCommerceAction.action_type), per month granularity. Counts exclude product impressions when requested via question_ops. This view groups product occurrences by month (YYYY-MM) and ecommerce_action_type so downstream queries can pivot to get counts per action.

sessions_core.name: sessions_core
sessions_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- key fields (keep original names/types where possible)
  CAST(visitorId AS INT64) AS visitorId,
  fullVisitorId,
  date,
  visitId,
  visitStartTime,
  -- device fields
  device.deviceCategory AS device_deviceCategory,
  device.browser AS device_browser,
  -- traffic / channel
  channelGrouping,
  -- totals
  totals.visits AS totals_visits,
  totals.hits AS totals_hits,
  totals.pageviews AS totals_pageviews,
  totals.transactionRevenue AS totals_transactionRevenue,
  -- carry table suffix for provenance (optional for debugging; can be removed if not desired)
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS _table_suffix
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE
  -- lift date range predicate out of the view; include all shards by default.
  TRUE
sessions_core.description: One row per session (visit) with canonicalized key fields and important session-level attributes extracted from the wildcard ga_sessions_* tables.

hits_transactions_exploded.name: hits_transactions_exploded
hits_transactions_exploded.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- session keys
  visitorId AS visitorId,
  fullVisitorId AS fullVisitorId,
  date AS date,
  visitId AS visitId,
  -- exploded hit fields (grain: visitorId, visitId, hitNumber)
  h.hitNumber AS hitNumber,
  h.time AS hit_time,
  h.hour AS hit_hour,
  h.minute AS hit_minute,
  -- hit-level transaction indicators (may be NULL when no transaction on hit)
  h.transaction.transactionId AS hit_transactionId,
  h.transaction.transactionRevenue AS hit_transactionRevenue,
  -- session-level device category for context
  device.deviceCategory AS session_device_deviceCategory
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
-- NOTE: filter shards as needed when querying the view; keep wildcards in view definition to allow date range filtering by caller
-- Caller should include: WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN 'YYYYMMDD' AND 'YYYYMMDD'
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(hits) AS h
hits_transactions_exploded.description: Explode session-level hits array into one row per hit and capture hit-level transaction indicators and hit date/session keys. Provides a row per hit that can be used to identify transaction hits and their session context.

visitor_first_dates.name: visitor_first_dates
visitor_first_dates.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(visitorId AS STRING) AS visitorId,
  MIN(date) AS first_visit_date,
  MIN(IF(hit.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL AND hit.transaction.transactionId != '', date, NULL)) AS first_transaction_date,
  MAX(IF(hit.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL AND hit.transaction.transactionId != '', 1, 0)) = 1 AS has_transaction
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS hit
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
GROUP BY
  visitorId
visitor_first_dates.description: Per visitor (visitorId) earliest session date and earliest transaction date (if any). Transaction date derived from hit-level transaction indicators. Keeps raw MIN dates (YYYYMMDD strings) and flags whether the transaction exists.

inpatient_charges_annual_rows.name: inpatient_charges_annual_rows
inpatient_charges_annual_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  provider_city AS provider_city,
  provider_state,
  drg_definition,
  total_discharges,
  average_total_payments,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS _table_suffix
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE
  -- lift year range literal out of the view; callers should filter _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015' (example)
  drg_definition IS NOT NULL
  AND provider_id IS NOT NULL
  AND total_discharges IS NOT NULL
  AND average_total_payments IS NOT NULL
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL
inpatient_charges_annual_rows.description: Row-level cohort of inpatient charge records from the sharded inpatient_charges_* tables with basic null filters applied. Useful as the canonical source of inpatient charge rows for a given year or year range.

drg_total_discharges_by_year.name: drg_total_discharges_by_year
drg_total_discharges_by_year.body_sql:
SELECT
  ic.drg_definition AS drg_definition,
  ic._table_suffix AS _table_suffix,
  SUM(ic.total_discharges) AS drg_total_discharges
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*` AS ic
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
GROUP BY
  drg_definition,
  _table_suffix
drg_total_discharges_by_year.description: Aggregated totals of total_discharges per drg_definition per source year (table suffix). Use to rank DRGs by total discharges in a year or range of years.

drg_city_level_measures_by_year.name: drg_city_level_measures_by_year
drg_city_level_measures_by_year.body_sql:
SELECT
  ic.drg_definition,
  ic.provider_city,
  ic._table_suffix,
  SUM(ic.total_discharges) AS city_total_discharges,
  SUM(IFNULL(ic.average_total_payments,0) * IFNULL(ic.total_discharges,0)) AS city_weighted_sum_total_payments
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*` AS ic
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
GROUP BY
  ic.drg_definition,
  ic.provider_city,
  ic._table_suffix
drg_city_level_measures_by_year.description: For each drg_definition and provider_city and source year (_TABLE_SUFFIX), compute city-level totals and weighted sums needed for weighted averages (sum of total_discharges, sum of average_total_payments * total_discharges). Useful to find top cities for a DRG in a year and to compute weighted average payments.

drug_exposure_2014_cohort.name: drug_exposure_2014_cohort
drug_exposure_2014_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.drug_exposure_id,
  d.person_id,
  d.drug_concept_id,
  d.drug_exposure_start_date,
  p.location_id
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` AS d
LEFT JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` AS p
ON
  d.person_id = p.person_id
drug_exposure_2014_cohort.description: Row-level cohort of drug_exposure records occurring in a calendar year (date filter left to question_ops). Exposes drug exposure identifiers and linking keys to person and date columns so downstream aggregations (counts by drug and geography) can be computed.

person_with_location.name: person_with_location
person_with_location.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.person_id AS person_id,
  p.location_id AS location_id,
  l.state AS state
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` AS p
LEFT JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.location` AS l
ON
  p.location_id = l.location_id
person_with_location.description: Denormalized person rows joined to their location attributes. Keeps person_id -> location_id and location.state so geographic joins and state-level grouping are easy.

outpatient_rows_by_provider_year_shard.name: outpatient_rows_by_provider_year_shard
outpatient_rows_by_provider_year_shard.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  average_total_payments,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
outpatient_rows_by_provider_year_shard.description: Row-level outpatient charge records, filtered to allow shard/year selection; keeps raw payment measures and provider identifiers for joining and aggregation.

inpatient_rows_by_provider_year_shard.name: inpatient_rows_by_provider_year_shard
inpatient_rows_by_provider_year_shard.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  average_total_payments,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN @start_year AND @end_year
inpatient_rows_by_provider_year_shard.description: Row-level inpatient charge records, filtered to allow shard/year selection; keeps raw payment measures and provider identifiers for joining and aggregation.

provider_yearly_payment_summary_by_sourc.name: provider_yearly_payment_summary_by_source
provider_yearly_payment_summary_by_sourc.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.provider_id AS provider_id,
  p.provider_name AS provider_name,
  p._TABLE_SUFFIX AS _TABLE_SUFFIX,
  'outpatient' AS source,
  AVG(p.average_total_payments) AS avg_average_total_payments
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*` AS p
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
GROUP BY p.provider_id, p.provider_name, p._TABLE_SUFFIX

UNION ALL

SELECT
  i.provider_id AS provider_id,
  i.provider_name AS provider_name,
  i._TABLE_SUFFIX AS _TABLE_SUFFIX,
  'inpatient' AS source,
  AVG(i.average_total_payments) AS avg_average_total_payments
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*` AS i
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
GROUP BY i.provider_id, i.provider_name, i._TABLE_SUFFIX
provider_yearly_payment_summary_by_sourc.description: Aggregate average_total_payments per provider per shard (year) separately for outpatient and inpatient sources. Produces one row per provider per _TABLE_SUFFIX per source so final queries can join outpatient and inpatient yearly measures by provider.

partd_drug_top_state_rank.name: partd_drug_top_state_rank
partd_drug_top_state_rank.body_sql:
SELECT
  drug_name,
  nppes_provider_state,
  SUM(total_claim_count) AS total_claim_count,
  SUM(total_drug_cost) AS total_drug_cost,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY drug_name ORDER BY SUM(total_claim_count) DESC) AS state_rank_for_drug
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
GROUP BY
  drug_name,
  nppes_provider_state
partd_drug_top_state_rank.description: Windowed ranking of states per drug_name by total_claim_count. Produces per (drug_name, nppes_provider_state) the total_claim_count and total_drug_cost and a rank (desc) so callers can easily select top-N states per drug.

inpatient_row_costs_wildcard.name: inpatient_row_costs_wildcard
inpatient_row_costs_wildcard.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS _table_suffix,
  drg_definition,
  total_discharges,
  average_medicare_payments,
  -- canonical inpatient row cost: average_medicare_payments * total_discharges
  SAFE_MULTIPLY(average_medicare_payments, CAST(total_discharges AS FLOAT64)) AS row_inpatient_cost
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE
  -- keep wildcard pattern for multi-year queries; caller should supply desired suffix range, e.g.
  -- WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
  TRUE
inpatient_row_costs_wildcard.description: One row per inpatient_charges_* row with canonical computed inpatient row cost (average_medicare_payments * total_discharges) and normalized provider identifiers; keeps the wildcard table access pattern for multi-year queries.

outpatient_row_costs_wildcard.name: outpatient_row_costs_wildcard
outpatient_row_costs_wildcard.body_sql:
SELECT
  oc.provider_id AS provider_id,
  oc.provider_name AS provider_name,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS _table_suffix,
  oc.apc AS apc,
  oc.outpatient_services AS outpatient_services,
  oc.average_total_payments AS average_total_payments,
  -- canonical row outpatient cost: average_total_payments * outpatient_services
  SAFE_CAST(oc.average_total_payments * oc.outpatient_services AS FLOAT64) AS row_outpatient_cost
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*` AS oc
WHERE
  -- Lift year-range filtering out of the view; keep view usable across shards.
  TRUE
outpatient_row_costs_wildcard.description: One row per outpatient_charges_* row with canonical computed outpatient row cost (average_total_payments * outpatient_services) and normalized provider identifiers; supports multi-year wildcard querying.

provider_yearly_inpatient_agg.name: provider_yearly_inpatient_agg
provider_yearly_inpatient_agg.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS year,
  COUNT(1) AS inpatient_row_count,
  SUM(average_total_payments) AS inpatient_sum_cost,
  AVG(average_total_payments) AS inpatient_avg_cost
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
GROUP BY
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX
provider_yearly_inpatient_agg.description: Aggregated inpatient measures per provider per year: count of rows, sum of row_inpatient_cost and average of row_inpatient_cost for each provider and year (year derived from _TABLE_SUFFIX). Designed to be grouped at provider_id + year so downstream queries can choose top providers or join to outpatient aggregates.

person_distinct.name: person_distinct
person_distinct.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.person_id AS person_id,
  p.year_of_birth AS year_of_birth,
  p.month_of_birth AS month_of_birth,
  p.day_of_birth AS day_of_birth,
  p.birth_datetime AS birth_datetime,
  p.gender_concept_id AS gender_concept_id,
  p.gender_source_value AS gender_source_value,
  p.location_id AS location_id,
  p.provider_id AS provider_id,
  p.care_site_id AS care_site_id
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` p
person_distinct.description: Canonical distinct persons from the person table, exposing person_id as the row key and birth / demographic reference columns for grouping/filters.

standard_concept_icd10cm_roots.name: standard_concept_icd10cm_roots
standard_concept_icd10cm_roots.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.concept_id AS concept_id,
  c.concept_code AS concept_code,
  c.concept_name AS concept_name,
  c.vocabulary_id AS vocabulary_id,
  c.standard_concept AS standard_concept,
  c.domain_id AS domain_id
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept` AS c
WHERE
  -- supply the ICD-10-CM vocabulary id as a literal when querying this view,
  -- e.g. WHERE icd10_vocab = 'ICD10CM' in the calling query; here we reference
  -- a parameter placeholder name for clarity (not evaluated in view DDL).
  c.vocabulary_id = @icd10_vocab
  AND c.standard_concept = 'S'
  -- ICD-10-CM codes are typically in the "ICD10CM" vocabulary and concept_code
  -- often starts with an alphanumeric root. No additional pattern filtering
  -- applied here so this view remains general for whichever vocabulary_id is supplied.
standard_concept_icd10cm_roots.description: Standard ICD-10-CM root concepts (one row per standard concept) filtered to vocabulary entries representing ICD-10-CM. This view is general: supply vocabulary_id string via question_ops if dataset uses a different literal.

condition_occurrence_standard_with_ances.name: condition_occurrence_standard_with_ancestor_links
condition_occurrence_standard_with_ances.body_sql:
SELECT
  co.condition_occurrence_id,
  co.person_id,
  co.condition_concept_id,
  co.condition_start_date,
  co.condition_start_datetime,
  co.condition_end_date,
  co.condition_end_datetime,
  ca.ancestor_concept_id,
  ca.descendant_concept_id,
  -- A direct match means the condition_concept_id equals the ancestor_concept_id
  CASE WHEN co.condition_concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_direct_match_to_ancestor
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.condition_occurrence` AS co
JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept` AS c
ON
  co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
  AND c.standard_concept = 'S'
JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor` AS ca
ON
  ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
condition_occurrence_standard_with_ances.description: Each condition_occurrence row where the condition_concept_id is a standard concept, joined to ancestor concept ids via concept_ancestor so you can identify if the occurrence maps to a given root concept or any of its descendants. Row-level is per condition_occurrence.

quinapril_concept_set.name: quinapril_concept_set
quinapril_concept_set.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- percentage_not_using_quinapril is calculated outside the view; this view provides the quinapril concept set (concept_id)
  concept_id
FROM (
  -- base concept list is provided at query time via a parameter; lift literals out of the view.
  -- Replace @base_concept_id_list with the list/array of base ancestor concept_id(s) at query time.
  -- Include the base concepts themselves and all descendant concepts via concept_ancestor.
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor`
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN UNNEST(@base_concept_id_list)
  UNION DISTINCT
  -- also include the base concept ids themselves to ensure they are present
  SELECT DISTINCT ancestor_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor`
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN UNNEST(@base_concept_id_list)
)

semantic_filters.ancestor_concept_id: PLACEHOLDER - to be supplied in question_ops (e.g. 35208)

quinapril_concept_set.description: Set of concept_ids that represent a base concept (provided at query time) and all its descendant drug concepts using concept_ancestor. This view is a reusable cohort of concepts reachable from a given ancestor concept.

person_drug_exposure_eras_in_observation.name: person_drug_exposure_eras_in_observation
person_drug_exposure_eras_in_observation.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- person_id carried through from underlying rows
  p.person_id AS person_id,
  -- exposure_type: 'exposure' for drug_exposure, 'era' for drug_era
  CASE WHEN de.drug_exposure_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'exposure' ELSE 'era' END AS exposure_type,
  -- exposure_id: drug_exposure_id or drug_era_id
  COALESCE(CAST(de.drug_exposure_id AS STRING), CAST(dea.drug_era_id AS STRING)) AS exposure_id,
  -- drug_concept_id from whichever table provides it
  COALESCE(de.drug_concept_id, dea.drug_concept_id) AS drug_concept_id,
  -- start_date / end_date preserved from raw rows
  COALESCE(de.drug_exposure_start_date, dea.drug_era_start_date) AS start_date,
  COALESCE(de.drug_exposure_end_date, dea.drug_era_end_date) AS end_date,
  -- observation_period fields (may be NULL if no matching observation_period)
  op.observation_period_id AS observation_period_id,
  op.observation_period_start_date AS observation_period_start_date,
  op.observation_period_end_date AS observation_period_end_date,
  -- overlaps_observation_period: true if exposure/era interval overlaps the observation_period interval
  CASE
    WHEN op.observation_period_id IS NULL THEN FALSE
    WHEN COALESCE(de.drug_exposure_start_date, dea.drug_era_start_date) IS NULL THEN FALSE
    WHEN COALESCE(de.drug_exposure_end_date, dea.drug_era_end_date) IS NULL THEN FALSE
    ELSE NOT (
      COALESCE(de.drug_exposure_end_date, dea.drug_era_end_date) < op.observation_period_start_date
      OR COALESCE(de.drug_exposure_start_date, dea.drug_era_start_date) > op.observation_period_end_date
    )
  END AS overlaps_observation_period
FROM
  -- persons to ensure joinability and to limit to known persons
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` AS p
-- left join drug_exposure (may be multiple per person)
LEFT JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` AS de
  ON de.person_id = p.person_id
-- left join drug_era (may be multiple per person)
LEFT JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_era` AS dea
  ON dea.person_id = p.person_id
-- observation_periods: join to any observation_period for the person.
-- This will produce multiple rows per exposure/era if multiple observation_periods exist.
LEFT JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.observation_period` AS op
  ON op.person_id = p.person_id
-- Filter to ensure we produce rows at the grain of person x exposure_id x exposure_type:
-- Keep rows where at least one of drug_exposure_id or drug_era_id is present.
WHERE
  de.drug_exposure_id IS NOT NULL OR dea.drug_era_id IS NOT NULL
person_drug_exposure_eras_in_observation.description: All drug_exposure and drug_era rows joined to a person's observation_periods and person row. One row per exposure_or_era_id (drug_exposure_id or drug_era_id) indicating the person, the drug_concept_id, the source table (exposure vs era), and whether the exposure/era overlaps the observation_period. Does not aggregate; preserves raw dates for overlap checks.

hurricane_track_points.name: hurricane_track_points
hurricane_track_points.body_sql:
SELECT
  sid,
  season,
  number,
  basin,
  name,
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  etl_timestamp
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
WHERE
  latitude IS NOT NULL
  AND longitude IS NOT NULL
hurricane_track_points.description: One row per observed track point for storms. Filters out points missing latitude or longitude and exposes core identifying and spatio-temporal columns needed to build ordered tracks.

storm_events_by_state_year.name: storm_events_by_state_year
storm_events_by_state_year.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- Expose raw state text so external mapping can normalize to abbreviations
  state AS state,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_begin_time) AS year,
  COUNT(1) AS events_in_year
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_*`
WHERE
  -- lift shard range literal out of the view; callers should filter _TABLE_SUFFIX when querying the view
  TRUE
  -- also guard against NULL event_begin_time so year extraction is well-defined
  AND event_begin_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  state,
  year
storm_events_by_state_year.description: Per-calendar-year per-state counts of storm events. Groups event rows by calendar year (derived from event_begin_time) and normalized state name/abbreviation placeholder. Leaves handling of abbreviations to question_ops or an external mapping; exposes the raw state column for mapping.

stations_base.name: stations_base
stations_base.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- key columns (preserve original identifiers)
  usaf,
  wban,
  -- other metadata columns (preserve names)
  name,
  country,
  state,
  call,
  lat,
  lon,
  elev,
  -- normalize begin and end to DATE; lift literals out of view (no literals used here)
  SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', NULLIF(begin, '')) AS begin,
  SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', NULLIF(`end`, '')) AS `end`
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
stations_base.description: Canonicalized station rows from the NOAA GSOD stations table exposing station identifiers and period-of-record/date fields normalized as dates.
counter_examples: Can you help me retrieve the average temperature, average wind speed, and precipitation for LaGuardia Airport in NYC on June 12 for each year from 2011 through 2020, specifically using the station ID 725030?

station_identifiers_location.name: station_identifiers_location
station_identifiers_location.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.usaf AS usaf,
  s.wban AS wban,
  s.name AS name,
  s.country AS country,
  s.state AS state,
  s.lat AS lat,
  s.lon AS lon,
  s.elev AS elev
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS s
station_identifiers_location.description: Station identifier and location attributes for joining weather observations to station metadata; preserves raw identifier columns and location fields per station.

stations_geolocation.name: stations_geolocation
stations_geolocation.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(usaf AS STRING) AS usaf,
  CAST(wban AS STRING) AS wban,
  lat,
  lon,
  elev,
  country,
  state
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
stations_geolocation.description: Subset of station rows containing only identifying and geographic columns useful for spatial or station-level filtering and grouping.
